integrity: Two separate C++17 enumerators agree on every tabulated row and all dyadic weight profiles. The first has an exact adjacent-block covering proof; the second uses the digit definition on a certified covering prefix. All integer statistics are exact. No independent human audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The tabulation is exact only for lengths 1..4096; an eight-pair factor formula is proved for all lengths, but no closed numerical formula or asymptotic is claimed. Equivalent unpublished, unindexed, or inaccessible tables cannot be excluded.
title: Exact finite 2-binomial spectrum of the Rudin–Shapiro word through length \(4096\)
